text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: It really is beautiful... this sea glass.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...Mom. I'm gonna do my best.
Lately, I've been running in lots of races, and...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
...? What is this?
My vision... it's getting blurry—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fatigued from her race, Furioso stumbled
and bumped into a shelf.
I ought to reconsider her upcoming racing schedule...
